data.narrative:
Viridian Space is a Pre-Seed stage company in Space & Aerospace founded by Rostislav Spektor and Matthew Feldman, with $2M+ in total capital raised. The sector comp universe includes 5 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers spanning scaled operators like SpaceX and Rocket Lab through emerging platforms like ICEYE and Sierra Space.

Of three valuation methods tested, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method anchors to the $2M raised proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for Pre-Seed to next-stage progression, yielding $5M. Peer-Median analysis was not viable—while 14 same-sector peers exist, insufficient datapoints met narrow stage and tier filters; broader sector medians would introduce unwarranted noise. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be executed; the public sector median P/S stands at 25.3x across 6 tickers, but Viridian's revenue is not on file, precluding application.

The single-method constraint limits precision. Stage-Progression alone supports a triangulated range of $4M–$6M (median $5M). Key uncertainties include the company's unreported revenue trajectory, product maturity within a capital-intensive sector, and whether the $2M base accurately reflects operational progress versus nominal funding rounds. A fuller valuation would require disclosure of revenue, customer traction, or technical milestones to validate this narrow band.
